run.scope: Frozen two-stage fixed-pool comparison; 32 sampling replicates on three development-inspected mechanisms; no superiority claim

interpretation: All predeclared conditions retained. Paired differences are policy minus uniform for the same estimator. Pointwise Monte Carlo intervals have no multiplicity adjustment and do not establish unseen-mechanism generalization.
